server.title: Tender MCP
server.description: Government tender search for AI agents. UK, EU and US procurement opportunities.

serverInfo.name: tender-mcp
serverInfo.description: Every sales and procurement agent monitors live contract opportunities -- but querying UK, EU, and US tender databases separately means 3 different APIs, 3 different authentication methods, and 3 different response formats. This server collapses that into one call. Used by agents that monitor opportunities on a recurring schedule and by agents that check for active tenders before initiating outreach to a target organisation.
